title: Integral pullback composition family
statement: For a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and for a scheme $T$ on which $\ell$ is invertible, let $D^b_c(T,\mathcal O_E)$ be the derived-complete integral constructible category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] and, for a morphism $f$ of such schemes, let $Lf^*$ be the integral constructible pullback of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Define an integral pullback composition family to be a choice, for every composable pair $h:Z\to W$, $k:W\to V$ of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible, of a natural isomorphism $L(k\circ h)^*\cong Lh^*\circ Lk^*$ of functors $D^b_c(V,\mathcal O_E)\to D^b_c(Z,\mathcal O_E)$. This is the type of such families; the finite-level reduction and associativity normalizations that single out the canonical family are conditions on a member of this type, stated by the integral pullback composition lemma, not part of this definition.
